description:
The all-new KBO K Series - best choice for your first E-bike! K Series stands out with five vibrant, fresh colors and showcases a compact, lightweight design that folds effortlessly within 20 seconds. At just 48lb without the battery, it folds quickly in two steps, offering portability and easy storage. With its budget-friendly price, it offers exceptional value while providing a range of up to 45 miles and superior shock absorption, ideal for city commutes, compact living, road trips, RV adventures, outdoor explorations, students and more! Make it your go-to e-bike without breaking the bank and embark on a cycling journey anew!
Featuring a built-in battery for rain and dust protection, anti-theft security, and stable center of gravity. The 500Wh capacity and BMS system ensure extended battery life and safety, offering up to 25 miles in electric mode and 45 miles in pedal-assist mode per charge, maintaining 80% capacity after 500 cycles.
With a 500W brushless geared motor, K1 delivers efficient and precise power output for sustained propulsion. Capable of achieving speeds of up to 20MPH and conquering 30° slopes, it adapts well to various riding conditions. The motor boasts a long-lasting durable lifespan, operates quietly, and requires minimal maintenance.
Fold K1&K2 effortlessly in two steps: release the frame clamp and shorten the handlebar stem. Within 20 seconds, they compactly pack up, with the battery removable in just 5 seconds. No space worries: fit them into car trunks, public transport, or narrow spaces, always ready for your next adventure!
Shimano 7-speed Gear Derailleur
The 7-speed gear derailleur allows for smooth and steady speed control, adapting to various riding conditions.
Front Suspension
The Dual Front Suspension Fork absorbs bumps, enhances traction, and improves safety and maneuverability across various riding conditions.
Mechanical Disc Brakes
The 160mm mechanical brakes offer a good balance between stopping power and control, providing more direct feedback and a sense of control to the riders.
Removable Battery
When folding the bike, the battery can be removed with a key in just 5 seconds for easier transport, charging, or theft prevention when leaving the bike unattended.
Multifunctional LCD Display
Multi-functional backlight display shows information including speed, odometer, PAS and battery capacity, etc.
Detachable Rear Rack
A sturdy and detachable rear rack with a load capacity of 280lb provides substantial cargo carrying capabilities and the convenience of removal when not in use.
48V US-certified Headlight
The 48V headlight offers bright, clear illumination, enhancing visibility in low-light or night conditions, thereby improving rider safety.
20" * 3" CHAOYANG Tire
20" x 3" fat tires with wider tire surface for superior traction and stability make it easier to ride on all terrain.
Alloy Fenders
Aluminum alloy fenders are corrosion-resistant, lightweight, and provide added protection for riders by preventing mud and debris from splashing.
